claim.text: The system took 1.5355 s to notice the vehicle, above the 0.3 s it is allowed.
Command delay was 0.0502 s, within the 0.1 s threshold.
Brake actuation delay was 0.14 s, within the 0.25 s threshold.
At 5.9 s the hazard onset reason was closing.
Time from hazard onset to impact was 2.1 s.
Witness lighting was daylight, and the independent recheck had the same value.
With nominal perception 0.2 s, command 0.05 s and tau 0.15 s, the counterfactual showed no contact and a minimum gap of 9.3705 m.
The brake log was complete, so the timing evidence is not inconclusive for missing brake data.
The primary contributing factor was late perception, with a 1.5355 s delay above the 0.3 s threshold while command and actuation remained within their thresholds.
